paragraphs.text:
The ceremonial robe catches your eye, and you settle on placing 
a bid. You sign your name on a paper with a realistic price and 
put your submission in with the rest. You wait for Mr. Warren 
to call out the robe’s winner.

• Make an Appraise or Credit Rating roll: if you succeed, go to 52; 
if you fail, go to 48.
